Triangle product uniform identity gives exact entire nonzero law. The standalone checker independently corroborated square, triangle, skew quadrilateral, atom, marked density and sharpness. No infinite claim depends on finite tests.

value.rationale: The natural small-fragment statistic for independent perimeter-endpoint chords has a previously unreported logarithmic corner regime, explicit two-term coefficient and rare-shape law. The reciprocal-sine angular optimum and sharp stability distinguish equiangular shapes, and the exact triangle distribution is a complete benchmark. This separates endpoint chords from invariant-line and uniform-angle fragmentation in a mathematically consequential way.
